skill.summary: Sync activities from Garmin China to Garmin Global using local timestamps and distance to avoid duplicates in a one-way sync process.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Adds a new --new-only option to sync only records newer than the last sync time (recommended for cron jobs).
- Script now exits silently if there are no new activities to sync and no failed retries.
- All output is now consistently in English.
- Documentation updated with new options and behavior details.
